import sys
from django.db import connection

def count_signups():
    country = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
    exact_match = len(sys.argv) > 2 and sys.argv[2] == "exact"
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        if country and exact_match:
            query = "SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM myapp_user WHERE country = %s GROUP BY country"

        else:
            query = f"SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM myapp_user WHERE country LIKE '%{country}%' GROUP BY country"

        print(result)
